chunks: From him, from Al-Sayyari, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Khalid, from Ahmad ibn Al-Mubarak, from Abu Uthman, from Dorust, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) who said:
The radish: its root cuts the phlegm, and its core digests, and its leaf causes urine to flow with a flow.
ai.seo_question: What are the health benefits of radish according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this hadith from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elucidates the specific therapeutic benefits of the radish (*al-fujl*), highlighting its root's ability to clear phlegm, its core's digestive aid, and its leaves' diuretic effect. This narration reflects the Shia tradition of integrating practical medicine with spiritual guidance, emphasizing the holistic healing properties of natural foods as signs of divine wisdom.
